A green "MELTING POT EUROPA" logo is visible in the top right corner. The scene then cuts to a different man with dark hair, a beard, and a black hoodie, sitting in front of a large bookshelf filled with books, speaking; text overlays show "Il mio nome è Darl" (My name is Darl), then "e facevo sempre parte del team I" (and I was always part of the team I), then "principalmente com" (mainly as), and finally "Non principalmente, ma" (Not mainly, but). The screen then turns black with yellow text "Okay, raccontatemi la storia della luventa." (Okay, tell me the story of the Juventa.), followed by a close-up of the front of a blue boat with "JUVENTA" written on its hull in white, docked in a harbor. This transitions to a wide shot of the "JUVENTA" boat at sea, with people in life vests on board and a smaller orange rescue boat alongside, engaging in rescue operations. An aerial view then shows the "JUVENTA" in the open sea, surrounded by smaller boats, orange floats, and numerous people in the water, indicating a large-scale rescue effort. The screen becomes black again, displaying yellow text "Quando è nata e perc" (When was it born and why), before returning to the first man speaking, with the text "Al" (At the).
